reviewer.summary: Source 8331185 / evidence 8a253b6 on pilot/public-launch. (A) OBSERVABILITY: backend exposes an unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics with 7 metric families (backend_up, uptime, rss, heap, pg_pool_connections, http_requests_total{method,status}, ratelimit_fallback_total, health_alerts_total); deploy/observability declares 27 alert rules + 4 SLO burn alerts + 4 Grafana dashboards (33 panels) and Slack-only Alertmanager receivers, all DECLARED and self-described as not deployed (README.md:96-98; register 28 = NOT_MEASURED). Of the 15 required signals only backend health and aggregate API error rate are PRESENT as metrics; auth failures, device revocations, AI gateway failures, AI latency, token usage, AI cost, tool refusal, tool execution, authorization denial, update failure, release version and deployment version are ABSENT as metrics (AI signals exist only as pino log fields, router.ts:57/61/65). Crash is PRESENT only via k8s kube-state-metrics rules. The single-host Caddy edge proxies every path to the backend (Caddyfile:14), so /metrics is not network-restricted on that deployment path (only the k8s HTTPRoute denies it). Production edge answers HTTP 530 (MEASURED 2026-09-13T04:17Z) so nothing is observable live. (B) SUPPORT: production password-reset delivery is ABSENT — the only Mailer implementation is createLoggingMailer (app.ts:128; mailer.ts:4 'does NOT send email'), no SMTP/provider dependency or env key exists, and in production the link is redacted from the log so the token never leaves the server. DNS MEASURED: MX = neuropause033-com.mail.protection.outlook.com (Microsoft 365) with SPF; apex has no A record; api.neuropause033.com resolves to Cloudflare and returns 530. A mail domain exists (EXISTS_UNVERIFIED); no support@/security@/abuse@/privacy@ address is published anywhere (ABSENT) and USER-SUPPORT.md:13 misstates DNS by omitting the live MX. (C) PRIVACY: the backend gateway persists no prompt/completion bodies (audit line = ids/provider/model/token counts, router.ts:57; grep confirms no DB/file writes in ai/*); Qdrant stores only {memoryId, orgId} (embeddingPipeline.ts:106). The desktop persists prompts+completions in plaintext JSON assistant-conversations.json (mode 0600, per-tenant cap 100x200, secret-screened) and question text in memory.json (no cap/TTL); AiAuditLog is in-memory only. Telemetry and crash reporting are local-only with no endpoint (telemetry.ts:2-5; crashReporter.ts:108 uploadToServer:false); no analytics SDK dependency exists. Device-direct lanes send content to api.anthropic.com / api.openai.com / localhost:11434. The gateway lane (gatewayClient/gatewayAgentLoop) is NOT wired into the desktop app — only apps/desktop/scripts/live-agent-loop.ts imports it — and the k8s HTTPRoute does not route /ai. The in-app privacy notice (docs/legal/PRIVACY.md) is a DRAFT dated 2026-08-07 with zero mention of AI providers and asserts 'no telemetry' while an opt-in local telemetry module exists. No audited invariant (AI != authority, default deny, client never final, stale approval, Human Authority) is contradicted by anything in this scope.

facts.fact: Backend metrics module exposes exactly seven metric families: neuropause_backend_up, neuropause_backend_uptime_seconds, neuropause_backend_resident_memory_bytes, neuropause_backend_heap_used_bytes, neuropause_pg_pool_connections{state}, neuropause_http_requests_total{method,status}, neuropause_ratelimit_fallback_total{bucket}, neuropause_health_alerts_total{component,state}.
Only three recorder functions exist (recordHttpRequest, recordRateLimitFallback, recordHealthAlert); there is no counter or histogram for auth, devices, AI, tools, authorization, updates or versions.
GET /metrics is mounted with no authentication middleware and serves renderMetrics with live pg pool counts; the comment says 'Network-restrict in prod'.

GET /live returns {status:'alive', uptime}; GET /health pings Postgres and Redis, calls reportHealthSnapshot, and returns 200/503 with components {database, redis} and uptime. Neither exposes a version.
HTTP request counting excludes /metrics, /health and /live and records method+status only (no route/path label).
Health alerting is edge-triggered per backend instance, records neuropause_health_alerts_total and a structured pino line, and dispatches to registered sinks; 'none is wired by default'.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (optional, validated URL) and ALERT_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT_MS (default 5000) are the only alert-destination env keys; when set, health transitions are POSTed as JSON {source, component, state, at, text}.
installWebhookAlertSink() is invoked once at boot before the server listens; it is a no-op returning false when ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is unset.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL is not set or documented in any committed deploy configuration: absent from docker-compose.prod.yml, docker-compose.edge.yml, .env.example, apps/backend/.env.example, deploy/kubernetes/*, deploy/helm/*.
facts.evidence: grep -rn ALERT_WEBHOOK deploy docker-compose*.yml apps/backend/.env.example .env.example -> no matches

facts.fact: deploy/observability contains 15 files: README.md, kube-prometheus-stack.values.yaml, servicemonitor-nems-backend.yaml, servicemonitor-cilium.yaml, blackbox-exporter.yaml, probe-nems-endpoints.yaml, prometheusrules-nems.yaml, prometheusrules-slo.yaml, alertmanager-config.yaml, dashboards-configmap.yaml, gen_dashboards.py, dashboards/{nems-backend-overview,nems-dependencies,nems-kubernetes,nems-slo}.json.

prometheusrules-nems.yaml declares 23 alerts with thresholds: BackendNoHealthyReplicas (available replicas==0 for 1m, critical), BackendTargetDown (up==0 for 3m, critical), EdgeDown (probe_success==0 for 2m, critical), HighErrorRate (5xx ratio>5% for 10m, warning), HighErrorRateCritical (>15% for 5m, critical), HighLatency (avg probe_duration>1s for 10m, warning), HighLatencyCritical (>3s for 5m, critical), BackendHighMemory (working_set/limit>90% for 10m, warning), BackendOOMKilled (last_terminated_reason==OOMKilled for 1m, critical), BackendCPUSaturation (>90% of limit for 15m, warning), BackendCrashLooping (CrashLoopBackOff for 5m, critical), DatabaseUnavailable (health_alerts{database,down} increase>0, critical), DatabasePoolSaturated (pool waiting>0 for 10m, warning), RedisUnavailable (health_alerts{redis,down} increase>0, critical), RedisFallbackEngaged (ratelimit_fallback increase>0, warning), CertificateExpiringSoon (<21d for 1h, warning), CertificateExpiringCritical (<7d for 30m, critical), DenylistLeak (/metrics 404 probe fails for 5m, warning), NodeNotReady (5m, critical), NodeDiskPressure (5m, critical), NodeFilesystemLow (<15% for 10m, warning), PersistentVolumeFillingUp (<15% for 10m, warning), NodeCPUSaturation (>90% for 15m, warning), PrometheusTargetMissing (up==0 for 5m, warning).

prometheusrules-slo.yaml declares recording rules nems:slo_edge_errors:ratio_rate{5m,30m,1h,6h}, nems:edge_probe_fast, nems:slo_edge_latency:ratio_rate{30m,6h}, nems:slo_app_errors:ratio_rate{5m,1h,6h} and 4 burn alerts: SLOAvailabilityFastBurn (14.4x of 0.1% over 5m&1h, critical), SLOAvailabilitySlowBurn (6x over 30m&6h, warning), SLOAppSuccessFastBurn (14.4x of 0.5% over 5m&1h, critical), SLOLatencyBudgetBurn (fast fraction<99% over 30m&6h, warning). SLO targets: availability 99.9%, latency 99% <=0.5s, app-success 99.5%.
The rules file itself states what is deliberately absent: queue-failure alerts and OAuth-specific failure alerts, because neuropause_http_requests_total has no route label.
README documents gaps: no per-route latency histogram, no OAuth/Store/Business/AI-runtime/Queue metrics, no managed-database internals, Cilium metrics no-op.

Dashboard panels — NEMS Backend Overview: Backend target up; Available replicas; Uptime; Edge availability (/health probe); TLS cert days remaining; HTTP request rate by status; 5xx error ratio; Memory: RSS & heap; Working set vs 512Mi limit; Rate-limit fallback (Redis degraded); PG pool connections. NEMS Database & Redis: Dependencies healthy (/health 200); Liveness (/live 200); PG pool waiting; PostgreSQL pool connections; Dependency up/down transitions (1h); Redis fallback engagements. NEMS Kubernetes Resources: Nodes Ready; Backend pod restarts (total); Node CPU utilisation; Node memory used; Node filesystem free; Backend pod CPU; Backend pod memory (working set); PVC free (monitoring storage). NEMS SLO / Latency / Availability: Edge availability now; Edge availability (24h); Latency SLI (30m, <=0.5s); App success (1h); Probe success over time; Edge HTTP duration; Availability error-budget burn (1h window); App 5xx ratio (5m/1h/6h).

Alertmanager routing: default receiver nems-ticket; severity=critical -> nems-page (repeat 1h); severity=warning -> nems-ticket (repeat 12h); both receivers are slackConfigs reading apiURL from Secret alertmanager-slack key url; channels '#nems-oncall-critical' and '#nems-oncall'; inhibit critical->warning on same alertname+service. Comment: 'Current delivery landscape: Slack only'; PagerDuty 'can be added later'.

Stack values: Prometheus retention 30d / retentionSize 40GB / 50Gi PVC, scrape 30s; Alertmanager retention 120h; Grafana admin from existingSecret grafana-admin, 5Gi persistence, dashboards sidecar; fallback inline route to a 'null' receiver until AlertmanagerConfig is applied.

The observability README states the stack 'has not been deployed by this change, and no dashboard data or alert history is claimed'; register 28 records status NOT_MEASURED and 'alert_rules: deploy/observability (DECLARED; mapper did not complete)'.

ServiceMonitor scrapes nems-backend port http path /metrics every 30s in namespace nems-prod; blackbox Probes target https://api.neuropause033.com/health and /live (tier=edge) every 30s and a /metrics http_404 denylist probe every 5m.

Every runbook_url in the alert rules points at github .../blob/phase-2/docs/operations/runbooks/<name>.md; all 12 referenced runbooks exist in the repo (backend-down, database-down, redis-down, gateway-failure, certificate-expiry, high-latency, deployment-rollback, disk-full, memory-exhaustion, node-failure, cluster-failure, oauth-outage) plus SLO.md.

Incident workflow is DECLARED as process + blank templates (severity levels, IC/Operator/Scribe/Comms roles, comms and postmortem templates) that 'records no incidents'; on-call rotation is 'the proposed default'.
k8s HTTPRoute enumerates public prefixes /auth /billing /devices /health /license /live /memory/semantic /organizations /store /sync; /metrics is deliberately absent; /ai is also absent.

The single-host production path (docker-compose.prod.yml + docker-compose.edge.yml + Caddyfile) reverse-proxies api.neuropause033.com to backend:4000 for all paths with no path filter; the backend published port is removed so TLS is the only ingress.
On the Caddy single-host path, GET /metrics (unauthenticated) is reachable from the public internet because Caddy forwards every path and app.ts applies no auth to it.

Backend logging is pino to stdout (no file/transport in production), level info, redacting req.headers.authorization, password, *.password, refreshToken, accessToken; no log retention/shipping configuration exists in the repo.

Semantic memory backfill embeds memory content server-side but the Qdrant point payload is only {memoryId, orgId}; memory text is not stored in the vector store.

Desktop assistant conversations are persisted to userData/assistant-conversations.json as plaintext JSON via atomic temp-file+rename with mode 0600; retention is capped per tenant at MAX_CONVERSATIONS=100 and MAX_MESSAGES=200; delete(id) is tenant-scoped; unscoped writes are refused.
AssistantMessage.text holds 'User text (possibly redacted) or the assistant's short text' plus an envelope; user text is passed through screenMemory (secret/PHI patterns) before storage.
AiAuditLog is an in-memory ring of 1000 records carrying tokens, cost, latency, model, prompt version, outcome — 'NEVER prompts, context text, responses, or secrets'; it is not written to disk.

Executive conversation memory stores the user's question text (content: question.trim()) as a MemoryItem in memory.json; temporary items expire in ~8h, 'today' at end of day, project/longterm never; secret screening refuses patterned credentials/cards/SSN/IBAN and best-effort medical text.

memory.json (MemoryStore) has 'No cap, no TTL, no eviction'; forget() appends a deletion tombstone for synced items so history stays recoverable; persisted as plaintext JSON mode 0600; memory-audit.json is capped at 5000 entries per tenant, mode 0600.

Device-direct AI lanes wired in providerManager send content to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages, https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions, or http://localhost:11434; none of the provider clients log prompt/message content.
